report.clinical_summary: The patient has Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) and is currently on a 'watch and wait' approach. They're generally feeling well, maintaining full-time work and family routines. They've presented with two new symptoms: a pea-sized lump in their neck (found by their wife) and mild headaches that started a few months ago. They're waiting on blood test results and have some anxiety about the uncertainty. They're comfortable with the watch-and-wait approach but have some curiosity about what more active treatment might involve. They're trying to maintain normalcy and not let uncertainty dominate their life.
